about: Choices no SDK index can make. sdk-lookup.cjs prints a rule when one of its entities matches. `choice: site` means the namespace depends on the site, not on the install.

rules.note: Call catalogVersioning.getCatalogVersion() first: V3 sites use productsV3, V1 sites use products. Support both paths, and request both scope sets plus SCOPE.STORES.CATALOG_READ_LIMITED. To search by name, V3 has productsV3.searchProducts() (queryProducts cannot filter on name); V1 has no search method, and its builder takes name only with startsWith.
Call catalogVersioning.getCatalogVersion() first: V3 sites use inventoryItemsV3, V1 sites use inventory. Request both scope sets.

Refunded orders: orders.searchOrders with a paymentStatus filter, then orderTransactions.listTransactionsForMultipleOrders(ids) once for the visible page. Refund events are the exception: they live in @wix/payments (namespace refunds), not in @wix/ecom.
queryLocations is admin-only although its scope is SCOPE.DC-MULTILOCATION.READ-LOCATIONS: route it to a backend endpoint and elevate it there.
getMember and queryMembers withhold PRIVATE members from visitor and member callers. getCurrentMember (the docs page is get-my-member) needs visitor or member authentication.
currentCartV2.addLineItemsToCurrentCart is visitor-callable although its scope is SCOPE.ECOM.MANAGE-ADMIN. Never elevate it.
